title: Remote viewers foresee catastrophic sea level rise by 2050

tellings.quote: >> So, a number of remote viewers have remote viewed the year 2050.

plain: Several remote viewers, people who claim to describe distant places or future times with the mind alone, are said to have looked at the year 2050 and seen catastrophic sea level rise swamping coastal cities. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, citing the remote viewers Stephan Schwartz and Lyn Buchanan; if true, it would be a warning of disaster within a few decades.
